body:
Part of #115.

## Why

`priceOf` (`src/stats.js:79`) reads `total_cost_usd` off the attempt row, then falls back to
`sessionFromLog` (`:363`), which parses the closing JSON object of `claude -p --output-format json`.

**`claude-bg` never emits that object.** Its log is a launch banner:

```
# 2026-08-28T01:29:42.943Z launch background agent for #103 attempt 1
backgrounded · dd1e06c1 · kb track #103 · ...
```

`claude-bg` is the **default profile** and the one the README calls the free path, so out of the box
`hkb stats` reports honestly that it has nothing:

```
spend      not recorded on any of the 1 worker attempt — only a harness whose
           log ends in Claude's final JSON reports one
```

Twenty attempts and thirteen merged PRs in one night produced zero cost data.

## What

Add a further fallback to `priceOf`: when the row has no `total_cost_usd` and the log yields nothing,
read the attempt's `transcript_path` and sum the per-message `usage` from the JSONL.

- Report turns and input/output tokens at minimum — that already beats nothing.
- A token→cost estimate is a reasonable next step, but it must be **labelled an estimate** in the
  output. Never present a derived number as a reported one.
- `hkb stats` should say which of the three it is showing for a given board: reported cost, estimate,
  or raw usage.

Frugality still applies (Value 3): read the transcript **only** when the cheaper sources are absent,
read it once per attempt, and never fetch it over the network — `transcript_path` is a local file and
only the host that ran the attempt has it, exactly as `sessionFromLog` already documents at `:360`.

## Done when

- [ ] `hkb stats` reports turns and tokens for a board whose attempts came from `claude-bg`.
- [ ] The output distinguishes reported cost from an estimate from raw usage.
- [ ] A missing or unreadable transcript degrades to today's message, never an error.
- [ ] `node --test test/stats.test.js` covers: row with cost, row with log-only, row with
      transcript-only, and row with nothing.

## Contract

- **This must not depend on #115's other child.** Cold nodes already carry `transcript_path` today, so
  build and test against those; the sibling only widens which attempts have the field.
- Touch only `src/stats.js` and `test/stats.test.js`. `src/hook.js` and `src/model.js`'s
  `SESSION_FIELDS` belong to the sibling — read them, do not change them.
goal: hkb stats reports turns and tokens for a claude-bg board instead of nothing
title: Spend from the transcript when the harness never reported it
